library(readr)

```{r catgeories}
categories <- c("outside_event","object_info","original_owner_return","mental_state_info",
                "physical_possession", "normative_judgments","other","not_an_explanation")
```

# Looking at coder agreement and resolving discprenacy
## Import and tidy up data
```{r import raw data}
# read in coders 1 and 2 judgments
coder1 <- read_csv("./data/exp-3and4/03.Coder1_fullsample_v1.csv")%>%
  rename_at(vars(categories), ~ paste("c1",categories,sep="_"))%>%mutate(row_id = 1:n())
coder1_long <- read_csv("./data/exp-3and4/03.Coder1_fullsample_v1.csv")%>%
  mutate(row_id = 1:n())%>%gather(category, response, outside_event:not_an_explanation)

coder2 <- read_csv("./data/exp-3and4/04.Coder2_fullsample_v1.csv")%>%
  rename_at(vars(categories), ~ paste("c2",categories,sep="_"))%>%mutate(row_id = 1:n())
coder2_long <- read_csv("./data/exp-3and4/04.Coder2_fullsample_v1.csv")%>%
  mutate(row_id = 1:n())%>%gather(category, response, outside_event:not_an_explanation)

# combine
coder_data <- coder1%>%left_join(coder2)
```

## Looking at coder consistencies by category
```{r create dataframe with consistency evaluations}
coder_consistency <- coder_data%>%
  mutate(outside_event=case_when(c1_outside_event==c2_outside_event ~ TRUE,
                   TRUE ~ FALSE),
         object_info=case_when(c1_object_info==c2_object_info ~ TRUE,
                   TRUE ~ FALSE),
         original_owner_return=case_when(c1_original_owner_return==c2_original_owner_return ~ TRUE,
                   TRUE ~ FALSE),
         mental_state_info=case_when(c1_mental_state_info==c2_mental_state_info ~ TRUE,
                   TRUE ~ FALSE),
         physical_possession=case_when(c1_physical_possession==c2_physical_possession ~ TRUE,
                   TRUE ~ FALSE),
         normative_judgments=case_when(c1_normative_judgments==c2_normative_judgments ~ TRUE,
                   TRUE ~ FALSE),
         other=case_when(c1_other==c2_other ~ TRUE,
                   TRUE ~ FALSE),
         not_an_explanation=case_when(c1_not_an_explanation==c2_not_an_explanation ~ TRUE,
                   TRUE ~ FALSE))%>%
  select(row_id, unique_id, written_response, outside_event, c1_outside_event,c2_outside_event,
         object_info, c1_object_info, c2_object_info, 
         original_owner_return, c1_original_owner_return, c2_original_owner_return,
         mental_state_info, c1_mental_state_info, c2_mental_state_info,
         physical_possession, c1_physical_possession, c2_physical_possession,
         normative_judgments, c1_normative_judgments, c2_normative_judgments,
         other, c1_other, c2_other,
         not_an_explanation, c1_not_an_explanation, c2_not_an_explanation)
```

```{r check percentage of consistency}
n_total_trials <- nrow(coder1)

# aggregate
coder_consistency%>%
  select(row_id, unique_id, outside_event,object_info, original_owner_return, mental_state_info,
         physical_possession, normative_judgments,other, not_an_explanation)%>%
  gather(category,is_consistent,outside_event:not_an_explanation)%>%
  summarise(sum(is_consistent),
            percentage = sum(is_consistent)/nrow(coder1_long))
cor.test(coder1_long$response, coder2_long$response, method="spearman")
```

# Export discrepant rows for Coder 3
```{r}
category_inconsistent_rows <- coder_consistency%>%
  filter(!(outside_event==T & object_info==T & original_owner_return==T & mental_state_info==T &
         physical_possession==T & normative_judgments==T & other==T & not_an_explanation==T))%>%
  select(row_id, unique_id, written_response, outside_event,object_info, original_owner_return, mental_state_info,
         physical_possession, normative_judgments,other, not_an_explanation)

category_inconsistent_rows_toExport <- category_inconsistent_rows%>%
  gather(category,is_consistent,outside_event:not_an_explanation)%>%
  mutate(is_consistent = case_when(is_consistent==T ~ "",
                                   TRUE ~ "X"))%>%
  spread(category, is_consistent)%>%
  select(row_id, unique_id, written_response, outside_event,object_info, original_owner_return, mental_state_info,
         physical_possession, normative_judgments,other, not_an_explanation)

# use write_csv() to export data
```

# Import Coder 3 responses and resolve discrepancy
```{r import data and combine dataframe}
coder3 <- read_csv("./data/exp-3and4/05.Coder3_discrepant_rows_v1.csv")%>%
  select(-"...1")%>%
  gather(category,response, outside_event:not_an_explanation)%>%
  filter(is.na(response)==F)%>%
  mutate(response=case_when(response=="Y" ~ 1, 
                            TRUE ~ 0))%>%
  rename(coder3 = response)

relevant_row_category <- coder3%>%select(row_id, unique_id, category)

coder1_inconsistent_rows <- relevant_row_category%>%
  left_join(coder1_long)%>%
  rename(coder1 = response)

coder2_inconsistent_rows <- relevant_row_category%>%
  left_join(coder2_long)%>%
  rename(coder2 = response)

all_coders <- coder3%>%left_join(coder1_inconsistent_rows)%>%left_join(coder2_inconsistent_rows)
```

```{r resolve discprenacy}
resolved_row_category <- all_coders%>%
  mutate(resolved_response = case_when(coder3==coder1 ~ coder1,TRUE ~ coder2))%>%
  select(row_id, unique_id, written_response, category, resolved_response)%>%
  mutate(row_category=paste(row_id,category,sep="-"))

resolve_temp1 <- resolved_row_category%>%
  left_join(coder1_long)%>%
  mutate(response=case_when(response==resolved_response ~ response, TRUE ~ resolved_response))%>%
  select(-resolved_response)

resolve_temp2 <- coder1_long%>%
  mutate(row_category=paste(row_id,category,sep="-"))%>%
  filter(!row_category %in% resolved_row_category$row_category)

final_data <- rbind(resolve_temp1,resolve_temp2)

# write_csv(final_data, "./data/exp-3and4/06.final_data")
```

# Read in final data for analyses
## Look at frequency of each category
Within the consistent rows, what percentage said "yes" (1) versus "no"(0)
```{r frequency of mentioning each category}
final_data%>%
  group_by(category)%>%
  summarise(mean(response))
```

## Looking at the causal relation for the original_owner_return category
```{r export data for coding}
return_category_forExport <- final_data%>%
  filter(category=="original_owner_return")%>%
  filter(response==1)%>%
  select(row_id, unique_id, written_response, category)%>%
  mutate(causal_direction = "")
```

```{r import and analyze data}
# coded data
return_category <- read_csv("./data/exp-3and4/07.Coding_original_owner_return_causal_direction.csv")

# Exp 3 and 4 ownership theory
ownership_theory <- read_csv("./data/exp-3and4/00.exp3and4-ownership-theory.csv")

nrow(return_category)

return_category%>%
  group_by(causal_direction_theory2consequence)%>%
  summarise(n=n(),
            perc = n/221)
```

## Ownership theory group by outside event categories
```{r category: outside events}
outside_event_theory <- final_data%>%
  filter(category=="outside_event")%>%
  filter(response==1)%>%
  left_join(ownership_theory)

outside_event_theory%>%
  group_by(which_theory)%>%
  summarise(n=n()/nrow(outside_event_theory))
```

```{r category: object info}
object_info_theory <- final_data%>%
  filter(category=="object_info")%>%
  filter(response==1)%>%
  left_join(ownership_theory)

object_info_theory%>%
  group_by(category, which_theory)%>%
  summarise(n=n()/nrow(object_info_theory))
```

```{r category: object return}
return_theory <- final_data%>%
  filter(category=="original_owner_return")%>%
  filter(response==1)%>%
  left_join(ownership_theory)

return_theory%>%
  group_by(category, which_theory)%>%
  summarise(n=n()/nrow(return_theory))
```
